Script.name: Stormhammer
Script.script:
-- design doc: -- the goal is to create an alias, stm, that chooses targets from your room to stormhammer -- the core of it is this: you need to be able to create a list, and then check that list against who is in the room, -- and then stormhammer in that order. -- In order to do this we need multiple parts: -- First, we need to grab a list of targets in the room. Once we have that, we look for our target. If that's found, -- then we start from there and loop through the list to choose the next targets. We will use getTargets with the -- argument targets ( a string ) to determine what targets to check against. -- for the target list, we'll pull from the target list until we run out. otherwise, we just check against -- players in the room and select the ones that come up matching criteria first.
thammer = thammer or {} thammer.target_list = thammer.target_list or "List"
local thammer_validate = { -- insert here the logic necessary to validate your targets based on inputs, ie city or All All = function(e) return true end
}
function thammer.getTargets(targets) local t = {} if target and thammer.players[target] then t[1] = target end if targets == "List" then for _, v in ipairs(tprio.list) do if thammer.players[v] and (not table.contains(t, v)) then t[#t+1] = v end if #t >= 3 then return t end end else for person, _ in pairs(thammer.players) do if thammer_validate[targets](person) then t[#t+1] = person end if #t >= 3 then return t end end end return t end
function thammer.cast() local staff, shield = "442968", "324970" -- insert your numbers here. Important!!!!!!!!!!
local targets = thammer.getTargets(thammer.target_list) -- pull a list of targets from gmcp.Room.Players up to 3 local list = table.concat(targets, " and ") sendAll(f"setalias stmpvp stand/wield {staff} {shield}/cast stormhammer at {list}", "queue add free stmpvp", false) end

Script.name: hammer_players
Script.script: function hammer_players(e) thammer = thammer or {} thammer.players = thammer.players or {} if e == "gmcp.Room.Players" then thammer.players = {} for _, v in ipairs(gmcp.Room.Players) do if not v.fullname:find("The soul of") then thammer.players[v.name] = true end end elseif e == "gmcp.Room.AddPlayer" then if not gmcp.Room.AddPlayer.fullname:find("The soul of") then thammer.players[gmcp.Room.AddPlayer.name] = true end elseif e == "gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer" then thammer.players[gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer] = nil end tprio_auto_target() -- display(thammer.players) -- this should be all we need to get going end
